scope.operation: Full fresh-body supplemental source audit; no automatic import

overlapWindow.basis: Previous successful per-ecosystem content checkpoint minus 24 hours; modified OR published. Exact complete canonical archive comparison also catches retroactive content edits.

scope.ingestionPolicy: Preserve 79 curated records: 57 overlays on eligible Reviewed records and 22 records outside the fixed scope. Only source id/aliases define identity. MAL and unmatched backlogs are not bulk imported.
scope.baselineRetrievalNote: Previous public report, inventory and source-body bundle remain as dated artifacts. All seven previous complete OSV ZIP bodies were available locally and verified against that report before comparison. No old body was reconstructed.

recovery.note: All seven previous ZIPs matched retained SHA256 and byte counts. All current and previous members were read with ZIP CRC checks, then compared as complete canonical JSON. No missing body was reconstructed.

limitations: Seven ecosystem exports have independent source update times; not all OSV or a single transactionally synchronized snapshot.
Only id/aliases create symmetric transitive identity. related/upstream and matching package names are not used as identity.
Alias matching does not establish matching affected ranges, package names, severity, withdrawal state, or maintainer-level review.
Backlog counts are source records including withdrawals and informational notices, not proven new independent vulnerabilities.
MAL records counted and compared separately; no MAL bulk import.

curatedBunApi.note: Existing curated records and withdrawal overrides preserved. No fresh maintainer/API recheck was warranted because no conventional-vulnerability source record changed.

ingestionResolution.note: Zero non-MAL source additions, modifications or removals across the seven official exports. All 67 changed source IDs are MAL reports (46 added, 21 modified), kept separate and not imported as conventional library vulnerabilities. Existing source differences and all curated data are preserved.

compressionNote: Public audit inventory, raw source-body bundle and optional status copy use deterministic lossless gzip with compressed/uncompressed hashes. Full OSV archive bodies are identified by immutable generation URL and SHA256; bundled original record bodies cover changed/overlap records plus documented discrepancies.

cisaKev.note: One ordinary fresh GET returned 403. No retry, bypass, alternate host or catalog conclusion. Existing unknown/unverified status and successful-fetch watermark preserved.
